cards.title: Would more hands-on dads create a more peaceful world?
cards.body: Evolutionary biologist Sarah Blaffer Hrdy explores how involved fatherhood could reshape society. She's rewritten the narrative around parental roles and child development based on scientific research.

cards.title: My son's back home – and my mothering skills gone
cards.body: An adult son returns to the family nest post-graduation, forcing parents to renegotiate their relationship. The essay explores the emotional and practical challenges of adult children living at home.

cards.title: Parents: please don't buy Grand Theft Auto VI for children
cards.body: The game is rated 18 and contains extreme sex, drugs, and violence unsuitable for minors. Parents need clear guidance on age-appropriate gaming to protect their children.

cards.title: My kid wants to play Grand Theft Auto. Now what?
cards.body: Parents face difficult decisions about video game content and their children's screen time. Expert guidance helps families navigate conversations around age-appropriate gaming and ratings.

cards.title: How Hugs Help Combat Anxiety and Pain
cards.body: New research shows physical affection like hugs can reduce childhood anxiety and pain levels. Touch-based comfort is an evidence-backed parenting tool for emotional regulation.

cards.title: Egg Donation: Is It Private, or a Secret?
cards.body: Parents using egg donation must navigate privacy versus secrecy with their children. Understanding this distinction is crucial for healthy family dynamics and child development.

cards.title: Why "Boundaries" Makes Boomer Parents Mad
cards.body: Adult children setting boundaries can feel threatening to older generations who value family togetherness. Research on intergenerational development explains these communication gaps.
